(6) Notwithstanding the provisions of subsection (5), when
any  movable  property,  including  any  movable  property
referred to in subsection (10), has been seized under this Act,
an authorized officer of the Commission other than the officer
who effected the seizure, may-

(a)
temporarily return the movable property to the owner
thereof,  or  to  the  person  from  whose  possession,
custody or control it was seized, or to such person as
may be entitled thereto, subject to such terms and
conditions as may be imposed, and, subject, in any
case, to sufficient security being furnished to ensure
that the movable property shall be surrendered on
the  demand  being  made  by  the  officer  who
authorized  the  release  and  that  such  terms  and
conditions, if any, shall be complied with; or

(b)
return the movable property to the owner thereof, or
to  the  person  from  whose  possession,  custody  or
control it was seized, or to such person as may be
entitled thereto, with liberty for the person to whom
the  movable  property  is  so  returned  to  dispose  of
the property, such return being subject to security
being furnished in an amount not less than an amount
which  represents  the  open  market  value  of  such
property on the date on which it is so returned.
